CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH  --------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, A.P.P For the Opp. Party No.2 : Mr. Rajesh Kr. Mahtha, Advocate --------
03/

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 125 of 2023, for the offences under Sections 376, 323 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code but the learned Court below has taken cognizance under Sections 376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Puja Kr. Lal, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st class, Lohardaga.
It appears that on 23.03.2018 at about 3:00 pm, petitioner tried to establish physical relationship with the complainant but could not succeed.
Thereafter, on the assurance of marriage, he performed sex with her.
Later on, he refused to marry her.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the parties lived in live-in-relationship for about five years and subsequently, after five years, this case has been instituted.
Learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that petitioner is a police personnel and out of fear, there is delay in filing of the case.
The parties have remained in live-in-relationship for about five years.
Considering the aforesaid facts; I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Birendra Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124033482/
